title: Blue, red and nothing in between
label: Brand gallery
lede: There is no archive of the 1992 packaging under a free license that we could find, so the photographs here are of the 2016 and 2017 re-releases, which reproduced the original label. The drawings are ours.

archive.caption: A retail display during the first return to US stores, with 1990s squiggles on the cardboard.
archive.alt: Crystal Pepsi bottles in a printed cardboard store display
archive.credit: Photo: Mike Mozart, via [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Crystal_Pepsi_(28416747103).jpg), CC BY 2.0. Trademarks belong to their owners; shown for commentary.

archive.caption: The 20-ounce bottle of the 2016 release, held up to the sun.
archive.alt: A clear plastic bottle of Crystal Pepsi against a blue sky
archive.credit: Photo: Smuckola, via [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Crystal_Pepsi_20oz.jpg), CC BY-SA 4.0. Trademarks belong to their owners; shown for commentary.

archive.caption: The label of the 2016 release, close up.
archive.alt: Close view of Crystal Pepsi labels on a row of bottles
archive.credit: Photo: Mike Mozart, via [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Crystal_Pepsi_(29001084616).jpg), CC BY 2.0. Trademarks belong to their owners; shown for commentary.

archive.caption: The 2017 display: “Last chance to taste the 90s.” PepsiCo’s release called it the last return.[^32]
archive.alt: Store display of Crystal Pepsi with a Last chance to taste the 90s sign
archive.credit: Photo: Forsaken Fotos, via [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Crystal_Pepsi.jpg), CC BY 2.0. Trademarks belong to their owners; shown for commentary.

archive.caption: A race car in Crystal Pepsi livery, photographed at a track in 2013. The uploader gives no further details and we have not identified the car.
archive.alt: A white race car with Crystal Pepsi lettering on a track
archive.credit: Photo: Lodahln, via [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Crystal_Pepsi_(9752844193).jpg), CC BY-SA 2.0. Trademarks belong to their owners; shown for commentary.
